completion_definition: Completed means an initial curated cross-reference pass: the complete supplied English source unit and each retained target passage were read, and each pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean exhaustive coverage or independent specialist approval.
source_language_scope: Supplied English passage comparison; no new Greek, Hebrew, critical-apparatus or UBS6/ECM verification.
method: Source: the Revelation staging text snapshot added to Saints-Translation at bf920386f6355064d4b7a5fd2f1ac4e99d8e5110 (Bespoke editorial revision of Revelation still pending). Every source unit was read with its imported OpenBible.info candidates resolved to Saints readings as leads; 1–3 specific connections were retained per unit and every retained pair was compared again by a separate AI-assisted reader, whose findings and resolutions are archived. Eleven units without usable leads were linked by the lead editor from the Saints text. Imported candidates earn no credit unless a pair is retained with its own explanation.
